posts.en:
dsh-lark-link is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. High-reliability Feishu/Lark bridge for DeepSeek Harness: QR one-click auth, card-based commands and intent-confirmation cards, at-least-once zero-loss outbox, media in/out, /doctor session-log ZIP, and a reusable DSH Web GUI that lands sessions in the right workspace.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-14a68d2f79ad74ccaed2.html
